n_seasons.note: fixed; same seed and inputs give identical output

home_edge_window.note: league home edge = mean implied margin of the last 306 closes (two tournaments) before the match; no look-ahead

avg_total_goals.note: PROVISIONAL 2026-11-15: realised goals per match over the last five tournaments (A2024-A2026) 2.86; football-data carries no totals, so no Pinnacle totals history. Re-set from the Pinnacle captures once 100 totals are on file. A fixture with a posted total uses it.

shared_goals_mean.note: CARRIED from the MLS model (Pinnacle ladders, 0.10). Not calibrated on Liga MX: no ladder history.

dc_rho.note: SET 2026-11-15 from scripts/calibrate.py draws (4463 lined matches 2013-2026, each at its close's own margin and the league's running total): result log-loss best at -0.05 (1.02246; 0 1.02305, -0.08 1.02249, -0.11 1.02279); engine draw rate 26.8% v devigged closes 26.4% v actual 27.0%. Same value as the MLS model.

rating_sd.note: CARRIED from the MLS model, then checked on the Liguilla backtest (see CLAUDE.md)

kalman_q_day.note: SET 2026-11-15 (the MLS value; scripts/calibrate.py kalman, 4450 closes scored walk-forward 2013-2026): rmse a week out 0.2163 at 0.03/0.25; 0.025 0.2161, 0.02 0.2166, 0.04 0.2182; flat along q/s = 0.12 as in MLS.

kalman_s.note: measurement sd of a Pinnacle close; see kalman_q_day (the ratio is what the grid pins down)

kalman_s_avg.note: measurement sd of a market-average close (football-data AvgC; the only close on file from Oct 2025 until our own Pinnacle captures began 2026-11-15). 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.4 tie (0.2163-0.2165).

kalman_s_posted.note: CARRIED from the MLS model: measurement sd of a posted (not yet closed) Pinnacle line

kalman_p0.note: prior sd of a new club

kalman_q_off.note: SET 2026-11-15: extra sd across a tournament break; 0.05 0.2154, 0.1 0.2156, 0.2 0.2164.

kalman_off_shrink.note: SET 2026-11-15: strengths revert 10% toward the mean across a tournament break (two breaks a year; see kalman_gap_days). 0.75 0.2170, 1.0 0.2159, 0.6 0.2216.

kalman_gap_days.note: SET 2026-11-15: a league-wide gap of 20 days or more is a tournament break (both the winter and the summer break count; MLS uses 45 for its one off-season). Grid: gap 20 / shrink 0.9 / q_off 0.05 gives 0.2154 a week out v 0.2163 at the MLS trio (45 / 0.75 / 0.10); the surface is flat (0.2154-0.2171 across shrink 0.75-1.0).

new_club_prior.note: CARRIED from the MLS model (expansion prior)

club_home_edge_enabled.note: ON 2026-11-15 from scripts/calibrate.py home: per-club home deltas (data/ratings/home_edges.csv, shrunk with k pseudo-games) fitted on closes before 2021-07 and scored on closes after: rmse of the close a week out 0.2431 without, 0.2333 with (k 50; k 25 0.2329, k 100 0.2342). Tijuana +0.19, Monterrey +0.07, Toluca +0.06; Atlas -0.07, San Luis -0.07. Deltas on file are fitted on every season (in sample for past seasons, as in the MLS model).

club_home_k.note: pseudo-games shrinking each club's home delta (the MLS value)

posted_line_shrink.note: a fixture with a fresh Pinnacle line (fetched within 3 days) is priced off Pinnacle (the MLS rule)

posted_in_fit.note: the current round's fresh Pinnacle lines enter the ratings as measurements (the MLS rule)

posted_fresh_days.note: a posted line older than this is ignored

shots_weight.note: SET 2026-11-15 on Zac's word ("Only do 1"): 15% of each rating comes from the shots proxy, 85% from the market filter (the MLS model's xG share). scripts/calib_shots.py, 666 closes Jul 2024 - Nov 2026 scored a week out: 0.2506 at 0, 0.2469 at 0.05, 0.2449 at 0.10, 0.2446 at 0.15, 0.2489 at 0.25; better than 0 in A2025, C2025, A2026, level in C2026 (0.2609 v 0.2622). 0 = off.

shots_coef.note: proxy goals per side = a x shots off target + b x shots on target, fitted on 821 games (ESPN match stats, Jul 2024 - Nov 2026); penalties left in

shots_half_life.note: days; the MLS xG half-life. 90 is worse (0.2466 v 0.2446 a week out at 15%).

shots_ridge.note: ridge toward zero in the proxy fit, in weight units (the MLS value)

late_rounds.note: SET 2026-11-15 (Zac: find why the top prices are uncertain and fix it). The closes of the last two regular rounds enter the ratings at sd late_round_sd instead of 0.25: those rounds are priced on rotation and dead rubbers (close v ratings 0.222 in rounds 15-16 and 0.254 in round 17 v 0.183 mid-tournament). Ratings on the morning of the first quarter-final scored on the 364 Liguilla closes of 26 Liguillas: 0.2321 with every close at full weight, 0.2131 at 2 rounds x 0.5 (quarter-finals 0.2268 -> 0.2055; better in 16 of 26); the whole-history yardstick a week out 0.2154 -> 0.2135 and the first three rounds of the next tournament 0.2414 -> 0.2369. Grid: 1 x 0.5 0.2201, 2 x 0.4 0.2164, 2 x 0.75 0.2114, 2 x 1.0 0.2115, 2 x 3.0 (out) 0.2124, 3 x 0.5 0.2133, 4 x 0.5 0.2116. Posted lines of those rounds take the same sd. 0 = off.

opta_weight.note: SET 2026-11-15 (Zac: make changes that tighten the top prices). 10% of each rating comes from Opta Power Rankings (the latest snapshot at or before the date, rescaled to the market's spread; ignored when older than opta_max_age_days). scripts/calib_sources.py opta, 1,399 closes Sep 2022 - Nov 2026 a week out: market alone 0.2392, +10% Opta 0.2362 (better in 9 of 9 tournaments), 20% 0.2363 (6 of 9), 30% 0.2394; on the 652 closes that also have the shots proxy: market 0.2502, shots 15% 0.2438, shots 15% + Opta 10% 0.2416, + Opta 20% 0.2425. MLS keeps Opta unweighted; here it is weighted, so footballdatabase is the only fully outside check. 0 = off.

opta_max_age_days.note: an Opta snapshot older than this gets no weight (the feed can be refused; the weight then goes back to the market)

kalman_sd_scale.note: SET 2026-11-15: the filter's stated uncertainty is 1.8x too wide. One-step-ahead errors of 4,463 closes divided by the filter's own predicted sd have sd 0.546 (1.00 = honest; 0.62 since 2023); only 0.2% beyond 2 sd. The close-tracking grid pins the ratio q/s, not their level (config note on kalman_q_day), so the ratings are right and their stated sd is not. Reported rating sd = filter sd x this (0.15 -> 0.08 goals). Ratings and prices are unchanged by it.

factors_enabled.note: ON 2026-11-15 (Zac: find what the lines price that the ratings do not, and fix it). Full-health ratings for status, as in the MLS model: every regular-season close and posted line enters the filter net of the two clubs' status on match morning (factor_out, factor_in), and each remaining league fixture gets its own status added back. scripts/calib_factors.py. Four flags since the same evening: out, in, fade, must. Rest days (+0.001, se 0.003), a short week (-0.004, se 0.011) and the first round back after a break of 11+ days (0.2016 v 0.2019) are priced at nothing.

factor_out.note: goals on a club's side once it cannot reach the last post-season place. SET 2026-11-15 from scripts/calib_factors.py, 3,975 regular closes 2013-2026, one regression of the close's miss v the ratings on the home-minus-away status flags: out -0.128 (se 0.017, n 198), in -0.049 (se 0.015, n 238), fade -0.069 (se 0.015, n 190), must +0.140 (se 0.025, n 92); rmse of the miss 0.2019 -> 0.1977. Status on match morning from the table as it stood; post-season cut by era (8; 12 in the repechaje years; 10 in the play-in years).

factor_in.note: goals on a club's side once it cannot fall out of the post-season places. See factor_out.

factor_fade.note: a club still alive that needs 60% or more of the points it can still win to reach the cut line, with five rounds or fewer left. See factor_out.

factor_must.note: a club still alive (neither in nor out) going into its last game. Adds to fade when both hold. See factor_out.

leg2_state.note: SET 2026-11-15 (Zac: do second leg game state). Goals on the second leg's expected margin per goal of its host's first-leg lead: the side ahead eases off, the side behind chases. 182 ties 2012-2026: Pinnacle's second-leg close moves -0.077 per goal of lead v the ratings (se 0.010; quarter-finals and semis; final -0.044, se 0.026); real second-leg margins move -0.27 (se 0.08). Set at the market's number. Pricing whole ties from the start it changes nothing measurable (tie log-loss 0.5981 -> 0.5980, se 0.0011; priced 0.638 v happened 0.637); it matters once a first leg is played and no second-leg line is posted yet (a posted line overrides it).

liguilla_total_adj.note: SET 2026-11-15: goals added to an unlined Liguilla leg's total. Real totals 2012-2026 v the same tournaments' league games (2.66): quarter-finals 2.77 (n 208, se 0.12: no change), semi-finals 2.37 (n 104, se 0.16), finals 2.25 (n 52, se 0.21).

club_totals_enabled.note: ON 2026-11-15 (Zac: use per-club totals and Pinnacle's team totals). An unlined game's total = avg_total_goals + both clubs' offsets (clipped 2.0-4.0); offsets are a ridge fit (club_totals_ridge) on Pinnacle's totals on file (posted lines and captured closes; a missing main total is read from the two team totals). Realised goals are NOT used: offsets fitted on goals predict the next total worse than a constant (rmse 1.636 v 1.630 at half-life 180, ridge 20; 1,243 games). Only 9 Pinnacle totals are on file on day one, so offsets start near zero and firm up through the Liguilla.

club_totals_ridge.note: pseudo-observations shrinking each club's total offset toward zero

injury_layer_enabled.note: ON 2026-11-15 (Zac: do injuries). Each open row of data/ratings/injuries.csv costs its club value x chance out x the share the ratings have not yet absorbed (injury_absorb ^ the club's closes since the row was first seen), on every remaining game while the row is open. Rows come from sportsgambler.com's Liga MX page each morning (fetch_injuries.py); rows already listed on the first import (2026-11-15) are dated 28 days back, so they cost nothing. NOT measured: there is no injury history to backtest (the MLS model measured its tier layer and found it double-counted once lines were in the ratings; the absorption share is what guards against that here).

injury_tiers.note: goals per match (the MLS values). A doubt counts half. Tier from ESPN lineups: starter = started 60%+ of the club's games this tournament, else squad; star and key only on Zac's word (edit the tier in injuries.csv; it is kept).

injury_absorb.note: share of an absence still unpriced after each close of the club since it began (the filter takes about 45% of a gap per close; MLS note on series_carry_played).

liga_mx._note: Apertura 2026: top 8 of the general table straight to the quarter-finals (no play-in; press). Bracket and tie-breaks as in the official Reglamento de Competencia 2024-25 (Art. 19-21, read 2026-11-15): 1 v 8, 2 v 7, 3 v 6, 4 v 5; two legs, the better-placed club picks its home leg (the second); a quarter-final or semi-final level on aggregate goes to the better-placed club; semi-finalists re-ranked 1-4 (1 v 4, 2 v 3); the final level on aggregate plays two 15-minute extra periods, then penalties. Table chain in the Reglamento: goal difference, goals for, away goals for, head-to-head, cociente table, fair play, draw; the model stops after away goals. The 2026-27 PDF (ligamx.net/cancha/reglamentos) could not be downloaded from this container. Final dates are the press-reported plan.
